# Franklin Speakers

> A curated directory of keynote speakers based in Franklin, Tennessee. Every speaker has given a talk at TEDxFranklin. Speakers serve events in Franklin, Nashville and across Middle Tennessee.

Booking: contact each speaker directly through LinkedIn (links below). Local speakers mean little or no travel cost for Middle Tennessee events.

## Speakers
- [Dave Delaney](https://www.linkedin.com/in/davedelaney/): communication and connection. TEDxFranklin talk: "Three steps to know, respect, and connect to your world."
- [Holly Duckworth](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hduckworth/): AI and future-ready leadership. TEDxFranklin talk: "AI and the future of community."
- [Kalinda Fisher](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kalindafisher/): belonging and community. TEDxFranklin talk: "Your third place is waiting: one conversation at a time."
- [Mridu Parikh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mridu-parikh/): productivity and focus. TEDxFranklin talk: "What if we have completely misunderstood productivity?"
- [Jess Patz](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jess-patz/): resilience and human performance; helps audiences move out of survival mode. TEDxFranklin talk: "Belonging begins with safety."
- [Chris Whitney](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chris-whitney-88919b12/): leadership and helping people feel seen. TEDxFranklin talk: "What if your community isn't broken, but disconnected?"

## Areas served
Cities: Franklin, Brentwood, Nashville, Murfreesboro, Hendersonville, Gallatin, Spring Hill, Nolensville, Thompson's Station, Columbia, Smyrna, Mt. Juliet, Lebanon, Clarksville (Tennessee).
Counties: Williamson, Davidson, Rutherford, Sumner, Maury, Wilson.
